title: Template Apps Quickstart: Visuals, README Diagrams & Release Screenshots
creator: Maya Chen
description:
Goal: Produce a complete visual asset set and README diagram package for the Template Apps quickstart used in docs, the Console walkthrough, and release notes. The deliverables should make it trivial for new engineers to run a reference app and for product docs to show consistent, annotated screenshots. This ticket covers asset design, annotated screenshots for desktop and mobile widths, a compact architecture/flow diagram for the README, export-ready SVG/PNG files, and naming conventions for the release pipeline.

Scope:
- Finalize 6 annotated screenshots (Desktop main flow, Desktop settings, Mobile main flow, Mobile settings, Template selection modal, Success flow with example output).
- Create one simplified README flow diagram (SVG) showing how Template App -> Redwood API -> Routing/Model selection -> Console rollout maps to the UI.
- Provide a 1-page README snippet (markdown-friendly image + alt text + 2-line summary) for docs inclusion.
- Add image variants: light mode and dark mode. Provide 2x and 3x retina exports for each PNG.
- Produce an assets index JSON (flat key/value file listing filenames, alt text, and intended use) and place it in the design shared Drive folder.

Design constraints & style:
- Use existing Redwood visual tokens: brand-blue #0066FF, neutral grays per tokens, 12px baseline.
- Use minimal overlay callouts (rounded 6px rectangles) with step numbers and short microcopy.
- Keep screenshots uncluttered: hide user PII and ephemeral data; replace with deterministic fixture text.

Acceptance criteria:
1) All required screenshots exported to Drive with naming convention and retina variants.
2) README flow diagram produced as editable SVG, optimized to <120KB when possible.
3) Assets index JSON added to Drive listing every file, alt text, and target consumer (docs/console/release).
4) PM and Engineering review comments addressed and marked as resolved.

Deliverables:
- Annotated screenshots (desktop and mobile; light/dark).
- README diagram (SVG + PNG fallback).
- assets-index.json (flat list).
- 2-paragraph README snippet for docs.
- Pull request in docs repo that imports the images and README snippet.

Notes on fidelity:
- Use the reference app data fixture sample-template-v2 so screenshots are reproducible.
- For console UI, enable dev mode to show route and model-selection rows for the screenshot.
- Prefer transparent backgrounds for modal export where appropriate.

Design handoff steps:
1) Upload assets to Drive folder and add links to this ticket.
2) Open PR in docs repo: docs/quickstarts/template-apps and include markdown snippet and image references.
3) Tag PM (Leah Ortiz) and ENG owner (Ravi Patel) for final sign-off.
